title: Linear algebra, visually
about: The first chapters of 3Blue1Brown's Essence of linear algebra, with a side path showing where matrices turn up next: neural networks.
description: A branching path through 3Blue1Brown's Essence of linear algebra: vectors, span and basis, linear transformations, matrix multiplication and the determinant, with a go-deeper link to neural networks.

track.title: Vectors
track.note: Three ways to think about a vector, and why the geometric one matters most here.

track.title: Linear combinations, span and basis vectors
track.note: Scaling and adding vectors, and the space they can reach.

track.title: Linear transformations and matrices
track.note: A matrix is a record of where the basis vectors land.

deeper.title: Where matrices show up next: neural networks
deeper.note: Each layer of a neural network is one of these transformations.

track.title: Matrix multiplication as composition
track.note: Multiplying matrices means applying one transformation after another.

track.title: The determinant
track.note: How much a transformation stretches or squashes area.
